sources.titre: BE 2018 : Our product sales backlog was $0.8 billion, equivalent to 1,384 systems, or 138 megawatts, as of December 31, 2018.
BE 2019 : Our product sales backlog was $1.1 billion, equivalent to 1,983 systems, or 198 megawatts, as of December 31, 2019.
BE 2020 : Our product sales backlog was $1.0 billion, equivalent to 1,994 systems, or 199.4 megawatts, as of December 31, 2020.
BE 2021 : Record ending backlog of $10.0 billion in the fourth quarter of 2022, compared to $8.5 billion in 2021.
BE 2022 : Record ending backlog of $10.0 billion in the fourth quarter of 2022, compared to $8.5 billion in 2021.
BE 2025 : Total current backlog of ~$20 billion; current product backlog of ~$6 billion, up ~2.5x YoY

kpis.commentaire: Reprise 17 sept 2026 (agent + verification Fable de chaque citation). Sujet : Rupture de perimetre en cours de serie. 2018 a 2020 : product sales backlog uniquement (10-K, definition etroite). 2021 et 2022 : total backlog (produit + insta. Serie partielle et heterogene. Ecart de definition entre backlog produit seul (2018-2020) et backlog total (2021-2022, 2025). Valeur 2025 approximative (source utilise le signe ~). Absence de donnee 2
